name: freebase_easy_strict_person_graph_v1
description: Strict two-endpoint graph with exactly one raw Profession value and a parsed birth or death year per endpoint; no L1/L2/L3 mapping.
notes: Academic advisor and Martial Art Instructor(s) retain the raw Easy subject-to-object direction; the suffix _raw avoids asserting a fully verified student-to-teacher orientation.
Influence denotes intellectual or artistic influence and is not evidence of face-to-face contact.
Social predicates are celebrity/peer-specific and remain distinct from kinship.
Member of, Leader of, works, places, professions, types, events, President, matches, rivalries, and ambiguous support/interview predicates are excluded from this export.
Both endpoints must have a unique link-file ID for the exported graph; this is provisional identity evidence, not perfect entity resolution.
